cards.text: Friend, Jesus just gave some hard teaching, and a lot of His disciples walked away. After this, Jesus travels all around Galilee. But there's one region He's staying out of: Judea.

cards.question: Why doesn't Jesus want to travel in Judea?

answers.text: The Jews there were trying to kill Him
Herod had banned Him from the region
A famine had spread across the land

cards.text: But the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles is near. And here come Jesus' brothers with ADVICE, because a holiday is coming and family ALWAYS has advice.

cards.question: With the feast coming, Jesus' brothers tell Him to leave Galilee and go to ___.
Why do Jesus' brothers want Him to go to Judea?

answers.text: So His disciples there can see His works
So He can make peace with the leaders
So He can teach in the synagogues there

cards.text: Their pitch: "For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world." Listen to them, friend. They're talking like a manager who just printed business cards. "Baby, we gotta get you SEEN!"

cards.question: Then John adds a quiet note about Jesus' brothers. True or false: His own brothers believed in Him.

cards.text: Jesus answers His brothers. And He is NOT being rushed. Me? One rattle of that junk drawer and I'd be up yelling "IS IT TIME? IS IT TIME?" Not Him.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells His brothers that His time has already come.
Jesus tells His brothers the world can't hate them, but it hates Him. Why does He say it hates Him?

answers.text: He testifies that its works are evil
He takes its crowds away from it

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them, "Go up to the feast on your own." He says He's not going up to this feast, because His time has not yet come.

cards.question: True or false: After telling His brothers this, Jesus stays behind in Galilee.
Once His brothers have gone up to the feast, Jesus goes up too. How does He go?

answers.text: Riding in on a young donkey

cards.text: So at the feast, the Jews are looking for Him and asking, "Where is He?" Friend, I KNOW that question. Years in a junk drawer, I heard it every time somebody dug around for the scissors.

cards.question: Many in the crowds at the feast are whispering about Jesus. What are they saying?

answers.text: Some call Him good and others a deceiver
All of them call Him the promised Messiah
All of them call Him a prophet from God

cards.question: The crowds are whispering, yet no one would speak ___ about Jesus for fear of the Jews.

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. Keep that oven warm, because this feast is just getting started.
